import os, ctypes, torch, b200probe, time
print(os.listdir('/tmp/solx'))
libs={k:ctypes.CDLL(f'/tmp/solx/{k}.so') for k in ['v1','v2','v3','v4','v5']}
for k,l in libs.items():
    l.gemm_launch.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*3+[ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p]
    l.gemm_info.restype=ctypes.c_long
    print(k,'stages,smem', divmod(l.gemm_info(),1000000))
dev='cuda'
torch.manual_seed(0)
W=torch.randn(18432,3072,device=dev); bias=torch.randn(18432,device=dev)
def mk(l):
    def fn(emb,W,bias,*outs):
        arr=(ctypes.c_void_p*6)(*[o.data_ptr() for o in outs])
        r=l.gemm_launch(emb.data_ptr(),W.data_ptr(),bias.data_ptr(),arr,emb.shape[0],148,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
        assert r==0, r
    return fn
def cub(emb,W,bias,tmp):
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=True
    torch.addmm(bias,emb,W.t(),out=tmp)
res={}
for B in [5,128,384,919]:
    emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device=dev)
    ref=(emb.double()@W.double().t()+bias.double())
    outs=[torch.zeros(B,3072,device=dev) for _ in range(6)]
    line=f'B={B}'
    for k,l in libs.items():
        mk(l)(emb,W,bias,*outs); torch.cuda.synchronize()
        got=torch.cat(outs,1).double()
        err=(got-ref).abs(); tol=0.002+1e-5*ref.abs()
        line+=f' | {k} err={err.max().item():.2e} fail={(err>tol).double().mean().item():.4f}'
    tmp=torch.empty(B,18432,device=dev); cub(emb,W,bias,tmp)
    err=(tmp.double()-ref).abs(); line+=f' | cublas err={err.max().item():.2e} fail={(err>0.002+1e-5*ref.abs()).double().mean().item():.4f}'
    print(line)
for rnd in range(2):
  for B in [5,128,384,919]:
    emb=torch.randn(B,3072,device=dev); outs=[torch.empty(B,3072,device=dev) for _ in range(6)]
    line=f'r{rnd} B={B}'
    for k,l in libs.items():
        t=b200probe.harness_time(mk(l),(emb,W,bias),outs,warmup=5,rep=20,tries=1); line+=f' {k}={t:.1f}'
    tmp=torch.empty(B,18432,device=dev)
    t=b200probe.harness_time(cub,(emb,W,bias),(tmp,),warmup=5,rep=20,tries=1); line+=f' cublas={t:.1f}'
    print(line, flush=True)
